title: Using ProteoCombiner to integrate bottom-up and top-down proteomics data to improve proteoform identification
protocol: Install ProteoCombiner by downloading it from https://proteocombiner.pasteur.fr.
Specify the directory containing result files from bottom-up proteomics experiments, including database and RAW files in mzML 1.1.0, MS2, MGF, ABSciex®, Agilent®, Waters® or Thermo® formats.
For PatternLab for Proteomics and Comet output files, use SEPro tool for filtering results.
Use the resulting *.sepr file(s) as input for ProteoCombiner.
Open the Results Browser window and click on Load option from the File menu.
Alternatively, open the main window and select Load Results from the File menu.
Export all combined results to Excel ( *.xlsx ) by selecting Excel file from the File menu Þ Export results.
Export all combined results to PDF by selecting PDF file from the File menu Þ Export results.
